# Third-party components

Faceveil bundles the MediaPipe Tasks Vision WebAssembly runtime (`public/wasm`) and two BlazeFace face detection models (`public/models`) from Google / the MediaPipe Authors. The package and models are made available under the Apache License, Version 2.0. A copy of that license is in `Apache-2.0.txt`.

- MediaPipe Tasks Vision: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision
- Models and documentation: https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_detector

React, Vite, Lucide, and other installed dependencies retain their own licenses in `node_modules` after installation.
